content: VERIFIED from official docs (docs.bullmq.io/guide/connections, fetched 2026-09-08): Worker throws an exception unless ioredis maxRetriesPerRequest is null (keep-forever semantics); producers should keep a capped value (default 20, can lower to 1) to fail fast in request paths. Worker and QueueEvents duplicate connections internally for blocking commands - the client must support duplicate(). ioredis keyPrefix is NOT compatible with BullMQ (use the BullMQ prefix option). Redis must run maxmemory-policy noeviction to avoid key eviction errors. Every class consumes at least one Redis connection; connection count multiplies with queues and workers.
